addressee_block:
The President
District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
[District Name], [State Name]
relevant_acts: Relevant sector-specific laws (e.g., RERA for real estate, Insurance Act for insurance disputes)
institution_rules: Pecuniary jurisdiction: District Commission handles claims up to Rs. 50 lakhs. Clearly state the value of goods/services and the compensation claimed. Mention the specific deficiency in service or unfair trade practice. File within 2 years of cause of action (mention if delayed and state reason). Attach purchase receipts, warranty cards, correspondence with opposite party, and rejection letter if any. For offences and procedures after 1 July 2024, cite the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) — NOT the repealed IPC 1860, CrPC 1973, or Indian Evidence Act 1872. The Prevention of Corruption Act 1988 and RTI Act 2005 remain in force and may be cited. If unsure of a new-code section number, use [VERIFY].
